draft.title: The Young Offenders Act 1997
card: The Young Offenders Act 1997 (NSW) lets police deal with some young people who commit offences without taking them to court. The aim is to keep them out of the court system where that is suitable.
a police officer tells the young person that the behaviour is wrong. It is the lightest response and is used for minor offences.
a more formal response, given by police or a specialist youth officer. It is recorded, and a parent or other adult is usually present.

a meeting of the young person, the victim, a convenor and others. They agree on an outcome plan, which may include an apology or repair work. The Act covers less serious offences, and some serious offences are left out.
draft.remember: Under the Act, police can use a warning, caution or conference instead of court.

a.q: What is the main purpose of the Young Offenders Act 1997?
opts: To deal with some young people outside the court system
To set the youngest age at which a child can be charged
To make sure young offenders are dealt with in court
To let courts give young offenders adult sentences
a.why: The Act gives police options such as warnings, cautions and conferences, so that some young people avoid court. The age at which a child can be charged is a separate idea, so that option is wrong.
a.clue: Think about what warnings, cautions and conferences replace.

b.q: Police in Orange find that Liam, 15, spray painted a bus shelter. It is his first offence and the damage is minor. Which response fits the Act?
opts: A caution instead of going to court
A trial in court before any other response
An adult sentence for the damage
No response, as the Act cannot cover property damage
b.why: The Act lets police use a warning, caution or conference for a less serious offence like this one. The option about no response is wrong because the Act covers minor offences, and the damage here is minor. The court options go against the Act's aim of keeping young people out of court.
b.clue: A minor first offence is the kind the Act is designed for.

a.best: To deal with some young people outside the court system

b.best: A caution instead of going to court
